generator_cmd:
truncate -s 69632 disk.img; printf 'label: dos
label-id: 0x1badc0de
start=64, size=72, type=83
' | sfdisk -q disk.img; dd if=luks1_essiv.bin of=disk.img bs=512 seek=64 conv=notrunc  (luks1_essiv.bin from the cryptsetup luksFormat above)
oracle_cmd: blkid -p --offset 32768 disk.img -> VERSION="1" TYPE="crypto_LUKS"; sfdisk -d disk.img -> start=64
